resources.string: WalkMeThrough supports five presentation styles. This intro step uses the full-screen presentation.
Card steps highlight a target view and show a floating dialog with a title, description, and navigation buttons.
Spotlight dims the screen and cuts out the target. Tap outside the highlight to continue.
Tooltips are compact callouts anchored to a target. Tap outside to move to the next step.
Banner steps slide a message up from the bottom while keeping the target highlighted.
You\'ve seen every WalkMeThrough presentation. Tap the help icon anytime to replay this tour.
